name: xTool F2
notes: Galvo laser. Blue 455 nm, infrared 1064 nm.
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension GS006 (exts/GS006), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 115 x 115); modules from defaultPower [5, 15] (redPower, laserPower) and laserTypeAlias BLUE 455 / RED 1064. Unverified: whether the 5 W infrared source is a fiber laser (kept as infrared). Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
